identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of HRS-8080 or SHR-A2009 Combined With Anti-tumor Therapy in Patients With Unresectable or Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multi-center, Open-label Phase Ib/II Clinical Study on the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Efficacy of HRS-8080 or SHR-A2009 Combined With Anti-tumor Therapy in Patients With Unresectable or Metastatic Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is designed to determine if treatments with the combination of HRS-8080 and SHR-A1811, the combination of HRS-8080 and SHR-A2009, the combination of SHR-A2009 and SHR-1316 are safe, tolerable, and has anti-cancer activity in patients with unresectable or metastatic breast cancer.

interventions.name: HRS-8080; SHR-A1811
interventions.description: Participants will receive HRS-8080 and SHR-A1811

interventions.name: HRS-8080; SHR-A2009
interventions.description: Participants will receive HRS-8080 and SHR-A2009

interventions.name: SHR-A2009; SHR-1316
interventions.description: Participants will receive SHR-A2009 and SHR-1316
